guideline: Annotators are provided a full Reddit post with a single automatically-identified affective state highlighted. We ask annotators to judge the term in context on 3 dimensions, beginning with whether the highlighted term reflects an affective state. If a term is judged to reflect an affective state, annotators are asked to judge whether the highlighted term better reflects an emotion or a mood and whether the highlighted term is used figuratively (e.g., "blue") or literally (e.g., "sad").
